propositions: Gate operations emit no incremental output at the default WARNING log level between LLM calls, causing supervising stall watchdogs to timeout despite the gate remaining active
Multi-phase gate pipelines contain 27-85 second silent gaps during material assembly, store hydration, and overlap-corpus retrieval phases where no instrumentation exists
Keepalive signals must be emitted synchronously at LLM-call, tool-call, and workflow-step boundaries, coalesced by elapsed-time comparison to prevent noise from rapid call bursts
Keepalive content must exclude prompt text, model responses, tool arguments, and payloads, emitting only operation/phase name, call index, and elapsed seconds to avoid sensitive data leakage

Implementation must remain purely additive with no background daemon thread, progress-gating, stall escalation, total-runtime cap, or timeout behavior change to preserve ADR 0089 compatibility and existing silence-tolerance tests
Documentation must warn that gate operations can exceed common 600-second supervisor stall budgets while silent between calls, and advise raising no-output budget thresholds
